findings.title: Mismatched quotation marks in the drying-complete toast (Macedonian opening „ closed with ASCII ")
findings.location: sushenjeGotovo:(g,o)=>`Сушењето заврши: ${g} г, оценка „${o}".`
findings.problem: The string opens the grade name with the correct Macedonian low opening quote „ but closes it with a straight ASCII double quote (U+0022). Macedonian typography requires „…“ (U+201E … U+201C). This is the only place in the player-facing text where a non-Cyrillic/non-Macedonian typographic character leaks into a Macedonian sentence, and it renders as a visibly lopsided quote pair.
findings.failure_scenario: Player harvests a plant, opens the Сушара tab and presses „Заврши сушење“. The toast reads: Сушењето заврши: 62 г, оценка „Одличен". The closing quote is the wrong glyph and sits at a different height/shape than the opening one.
findings.fix: Change the template literal to use the proper closing quote: `Сушењето заврши: ${g} г, оценка „${o}“.` (escape the backtick-safe string; the ASCII " becomes “ U+201C).

findings.title: Singular/plural agreement broken: "Имаш 1 семки" in the shop panel
findings.location: panelProdavnica: ${imam ? ` · Имаш ${imam} семки` : ""}
findings.problem: The word „семки“ is hard-coded in the plural. In Macedonian the counted noun after 1 must be singular: „1 семка“, not „1 семки“. Every count of exactly one displays ungrammatically.
findings.failure_scenario: A brand-new game starts with `semki: {skopsko: 1}` (novaIgra). The player opens Продавница on the very first screen and the Скопско Зелено card reads „· Имаш 1 семки“. Same happens any time a stock drops to or is bought up to exactly one.
findings.fix: Pluralize conditionally: ` · Имаш ${imam} ${imam === 1 ? "семка" : "семки"}` (and apply the same rule anywhere else a seed count is printed).

findings.title: Nitrogen-deficiency button says the opposite of what the action does: „Ѓубри против азот“
findings.location: `<button class="opasna" onclick="nahrani(${i})">Ѓубри против азот</button>`
findings.problem: The event is „Недостаток на азот“ (nitrogen DEFICIENCY) and the cure is to add nitrogen via ѓубрење. „Ѓубри против азот“ literally means "fertilize against nitrogen", i.e. fertilize to get rid of nitrogen — the reverse of the game mechanic and of what a Macedonian grower would ever say. The preposition „против“ is copied from the pest buttons (акарицид/фунгицид против штетник), where it makes sense, and pasted onto a deficiency, where it does not.
findings.failure_scenario: A plant contracts the `azot` event. The red action button appears reading „Ѓубри против азот“. The player reads it as "fertilizer that removes nitrogen" and is confused about why feeding the plant (nahrani) fixes a nitrogen problem — the button text contradicts TEKST.samoGubrenje („Ова се лекува со ѓубрење…“).
findings.fix: Replace the caption with „Ѓубри со азот“ or „Додај азот“ (or „Наѓубри — недостаток на азот“), so the label states that nitrogen is being supplied, not removed.

findings.title: Missing definite article: „Оди во сушара.“
findings.location: berba:(g,s)=>`Берба на ${s}: ${g} г мокра маса. Оди во сушара.`
findings.problem: Macedonian marks a known, specific location with the postposed definite article. The player's drying room is a specific, unique facility already referred to elsewhere in the game as „Сушарата е празна“ and the tab „Сушара“. Bare „во сушара“ reads as "into some drying room" and is ungrammatical for the intended reference.
findings.failure_scenario: Player presses „🌾 Обери“. Toast: „Берба на Вардар Куш: 386 г мокра маса. Оди во сушара.“ A native reader stumbles on the missing article; the sentence sounds like machine translation.
findings.fix: Change to „Оди во сушарата.“

findings.title: „г мокро“ is not grammatical and contradicts „г мокра маса“ used elsewhere
findings.location: panelSushara: ${Math.round(s.gramaVlazno)} г мокро
findings.problem: „мокро“ is a bare neuter adjective/adverb with no noun to agree with — „386 г мокро“ has nothing for „мокро“ to modify (грам is masculine). The same quantity is described correctly two functions earlier as „г мокра маса“. Growers in Macedonian say „свежа маса“ or „мокра маса“, never a dangling „мокро“.
findings.failure_scenario: Player opens the Сушара tab. The batch header shows „386 г мокро“ while the harvest toast that produced it said „386 г мокра маса“ — two different, one ungrammatical, labels for the same number.
findings.fix: Use the same phrase in both places: „${Math.round(s.gramaVlazno)} г мокра маса“ (or „свежа маса“ if you prefer the standard horticultural term).

findings.title: Latin script inside a Cyrillic UI: lamp named „ЛЕД Full-Spectrum“
findings.location: {id:"leds", ime:"ЛЕД Full-Spectrum", cena:2400000, ...}
findings.problem: Every other lamp name is transliterated („Флуо“, „ХПС“, „ЛЕД“) but this one half-transliterates and then drops raw English Latin text into the Macedonian string. It is displayed both in the HUD („Ламба“ stat) and in the Надградби panel, so untransliterated Latin appears next to Cyrillic on screen.
findings.failure_scenario: Player reaches level 9 and buys the top lamp. The HUD stat under „Ламба“ now reads „ЛЕД Full-Spectrum“, mixing scripts in a 4-character-wide stat box on an otherwise all-Cyrillic page.
findings.fix: Rename to „ЛЕД со полн спектар“ (or „ЛЕД полн спектар“), matching the transliteration convention of the other three lamps.

findings.title: „Вработен работник“ is a pleonasm
findings.location: {id:"rabotnik", ime:"Вработен работник", cena:900000, ...}
findings.problem: In Macedonian „вработен“ already denotes an employed person (a noun in its own right), so „вработен работник“ says "an employed worker" — redundant and stilted. A native would name this upgrade „Вработен“, „Работник“ or „Најмен работник“.
findings.failure_scenario: Player opens the Надградби tab and reads the upgrade card title „Вработен работник“, which reads as a translation artifact rather than natural Macedonian.
findings.fix: Rename to „Најмен работник“ (or simply „Работник“).

findings.title: „идеалниот прозорец“ is an English calque for a time window
findings.location: opis:"Сушењето е 40% побрзо, а идеалниот прозорец се шири на 8–14 дена."
findings.problem: „Прозорец“ in Macedonian means a window in a wall or a GUI window; it is not used for a time interval. "Ideal window" is a direct calque from English. A Macedonian grower would say „идеалниот период“ or „идеалниот интервал“.
findings.failure_scenario: Player reads the Професионална сушара upgrade description in the Надградби tab and parses „идеалниот прозорец се шири на 8–14 дена“ as something about a physical window on the drying shed.
findings.fix: Rewrite as „…а идеалниот период се проширува на 8–14 дена.“

findings.title: „шансата за штетници“ — wrong register; „шанса“ implies a desirable outcome
findings.location: opis:"Ја намалува шансата за штетници за 60%."
findings.problem: In Macedonian „шанса“ carries a positive connotation (an opportunity, a chance to succeed). For an undesirable event one uses „веројатност“ or „ризик“. „Шансата за штетници“ reads as "the opportunity for pests", which is the wrong sense.
findings.failure_scenario: Player reads the Клима-систем card in Надградби: „Ја намалува шансата за штетници за 60%.“ The sentence is understandable but reads as a literal rendering of English "chance".
findings.fix: „Ја намалува веројатноста за штетници за 60%.“ (or „Го намалува ризикот од штетници за 60%.“)

findings.title: Strain name „Шар Планина Хаза“: „Хаза“ is not a valid rendering of "Haze", and the place name is not adjectivized
findings.location: {id:"shar", ime:"Шар Планина Хаза", cena:3200, ...}
findings.problem: Two problems in one name. (1) „Хаза“ is not a Macedonian word and is not the transliteration of the cannabis term "Haze" — that would be „Хејз“. (2) All the other place-derived strains correctly use the adjectival form agreeing with the head noun („Пелистерска Магла“, „Охридски Кристал“, „Дојранска Ноќ“, „Скопско Зелено“); this one leaves the toponym in the bare nominative. The established Macedonian adjective from Шар Планина is „шарпланински“ (cf. шарпланинец).
findings.failure_scenario: A level-8 player opens Продавница and sees „Шар Планина Хаза“ listed among four correctly-formed adjectival strain names; the label also appears on the plant tile via .znak-sorta, where it reads as a broken, unattributable word.
findings.fix: Rename to „Шарпланински Хејз“ (adjective + correct transliteration) or, to stay in the fog/night imagery of the other strains, „Шарпланинска Магла“.

findings.title: Imperative with a missing definite object: „Заврши сушење“
findings.location: <button onclick="zavrsiSushenje(${s.id})">Заврши сушење</button>
findings.problem: Macedonian transitive imperatives with a specific, already-introduced object take the definite form (and usually a doubling clitic): „Заврши го сушењето“. Bare „Заврши сушење“ is telegraphic and ungrammatical for a specific batch already visible on the card. The same bare form is repeated in the empty-warehouse hint.
findings.failure_scenario: Player opens Сушара with a batch in progress; the action button reads „Заврши сушење“. Switching to Магацин while empty shows „Заврши сушење за да добиеш производ.“ — both read as clipped headline-style text rather than an instruction.
findings.fix: Use „Заврши го сушењето“ on the button and „Заврши го сушењето за да добиеш производ.“ in the empty-warehouse message.

findings.title: Overripe penalty is inert — passive recovery is 2× larger, so an overripe plant never loses health
findings.location: tikni(), the `else { r.faza = "ZRELO"; ... }` branch — `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100);`
findings.problem: The overripe penalty is the only health term scaled by `delDena` (0.125), giving 1.5 health/day. Every other health term is applied per tick: `OPORAVUVANJE` (0.4) is added once per tick = 3.2 health/day. The overripe branch also does not set `dobro = false`, so recovery still applies. Net change for an overripe but otherwise well-tended plant is `+0.4 - 0.1875 = +0.2125` per tick, i.e. health climbs and pins at 100. The comment on the line above ("Презревањето трајно го симнува квалитетот преку здравјето") and the `TEKST.prezrelo` warning both promise a consequence that the code can never deliver.
findings.failure_scenario: Plant Скопско Зелено, keep water/nutrients in range (or buy `navodnuvanje` + `rabotnik`, after which it is automatic). Let the plant sit past `CHASA_ZRELO_PROZOR` (14 game days after ripening ≈ 28 real seconds). The ⚠️ toast fires once, but `r.zdravje` stays at 100 indefinitely, `zbirZdravje/brojTikovi` stays ~100, and harvesting after 100 overripe days yields exactly the same quality/grade as harvesting on the first ripe tick. Waiting is strictly free.
findings.fix: In the ZRELO branch, when `preku > 0`, set `dobro = false` before the recovery check (move the overripe block above the `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` line and fold the penalty into `delta`), and drop the `* delDena` scaling so the penalty is per-tick like `STETA_SUSA`/`OPORAVUVANJE` — e.g. `delta -= KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN; dobro = false;`.

findings.title: Side panel innerHTML is rebuilt every game day (~2 real seconds), resetting scroll and swallowing in-flight clicks
findings.location: iscrtajPanel() — `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()` / `panelSushara()` / `panelMagacin()` / `panelNadgradbi()`; dirty flag set by `if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }` in tikni()
findings.problem: `panelValjaSe` is set unconditionally on every new game day by the market-drift block, and additionally by the sushara loop whenever `Math.floor(serija.denovi)` changes. A game day is 8 ticks = 2 real seconds, so `#sodrzina.innerHTML` is wholesale replaced at least every 2 s no matter which tab is open. `#sodrzina` is the scroll container (`max-height:calc(100vh - 190px); overflow-y:auto`), so replacing its children collapses content height and resets `scrollTop` to 0. It also destroys every button node in the panel, so any click whose mousedown and mouseup straddle a rebuild never produces a `click` event. The in-place comparison guard that `postaviAkcii()` uses for bed buttons has no equivalent here.
findings.failure_scenario: Harvest and dry ~8 batches so the Магацин list overflows the panel. Open Магацин and scroll to the bottom to reach the last batch's Продај button. Every ~2 seconds the list jumps back to the top mid-interaction; and roughly one press in twenty is dropped entirely (button visually depresses, nothing happens) because the node was replaced between mousedown and mouseup.
findings.fix: In `iscrtajPanel()`, preserve scroll and skip no-op writes: `const el = document.getElementById("sodrzina"); const skrol = el.scrollTop; const html = (aktivnoJazice === "prodavnica") ? panelProdavnica() : ...; if (el.innerHTML !== html) { el.innerHTML = html; el.scrollTop = skrol; }`

findings.title: localStorage failure re-notifies forever — a toast every 10 seconds for the whole session
findings.location: zachuvaj() — `catch(e){ izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska"); }`, driven by `if (++brojacTikovi % KONFIG.AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI === 0) zachuvaj();`
findings.problem: Autosave runs every `AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI` (40) ticks = every 10 real seconds. When `localStorage.setItem` throws — storage disabled by cookie/site-data blocking, Safari private browsing, or `QuotaExceededError` — the catch fires an error toast every single time, with no once-only guard. The failure condition is permanent for the session, so the user gets an unbounded stream of identical red toasts (each living 3.6 s, so 1–2 are always on screen) covering the bottom-right corner for as long as the tab is open, plus one more on `beforeunload`.
findings.failure_scenario: Open the game in Chrome with "Block all cookies"/site data blocked for the origin (or Safari Private Browsing). `localStorage.setItem` throws on every autosave. From 10 seconds in, a "Зачувувањето не успеа" toast appears every 10 seconds indefinitely and permanently occludes the notification corner.
findings.fix: Add a module-scope flag and warn once: `let sejvOtkazan = false;` then in the catch `if (!sejvOtkazan){ sejvOtkazan = true; izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska"); }` (optionally skip further `setItem` attempts once the flag is set).

findings.title: vchitaj() merges `statistika` from the save unvalidated, letting NaN/undefined into state and the HUD
findings.location: vchitaj() — `statistika: Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})`
findings.problem: Every other field in `vchitaj()` is guarded with `Number.isFinite` (the inline comment even states the goal: "за оштетен сејв да не внесе NaN во парите"), but `statistika` is merged wholesale. Any non-numeric or missing-but-present value in the saved object is copied straight into live state. `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama` is then rendered as `Math.round(sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama) + " г"`, and `zavrsiSushenje` does `+= grama` on it, so a bad value is sticky and gets written back by the next autosave.
findings.failure_scenario: With a corrupted/hand-edited save, set `s.statistika.vkupnoGrama` to `null` or `"120"` in `localStorage["zelena-imperija-sejv"]` and reload. The HUD "Вкупна берба" shows `NaN г` (or, for the string case, becomes NaN after the first `+=` in `zavrsiSushenje`) and stays that way for every subsequent session, since the poisoned value is re-saved.
findings.fix: Validate each field the same way the rest of the loader does, e.g. `const st = s.statistika || {}; const broj = (v, d) => Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0 ? v : d; sostojba.statistika = { vkupnoBerbi: broj(st.vkupnoBerbi, 0), vkupnoGrama: broj(st.vkupnoGrama, 0), vkupnoZaraboteno: broj(st.vkupnoZaraboteno, 0) };`

findings.title: Over-ripening penalty is fully cancelled by passive health recovery — the 14-day ripe window costs nothing, and neglect can be repaired by parking a plant in ZRELO
findings.location: tikni(), the `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` / `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje;` lines and the `else { r.faza = "ZRELO"; ... KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena ... }` block
findings.problem: KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN is 1.5 per game DAY, while OPORAVUVANJE is 0.4 per TICK = 3.2 per game day for any plant whose voda/hraniva are merely in range and has no pest. Net drift while over-ripe is +1.7/day, so health pins at the clamp. Worse, `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` runs BEFORE the over-ripe subtraction in the same tick, so the number folded into the lifetime average is the post-recovery clamped 100 every single tick — the penalty never touches `prosekZdravje` at all. Since `prosekZdravje = zbirZdravje / brojTikovi` is an unweighted lifetime mean and is the dominant input to BOTH presmetajPrinos and presmetajKvalitet, leaving a plant ripe indefinitely is free, and it actively launders away earlier neglect. Spec §5 says "Past the 14-day ripe window the plant over-ripens: quality decays 1.5 points per game day" — measured decay is zero.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured, deterministic: plant Скопско Зелено with Автоматско наводнување + Вработен работник bought, never touch it again. It reaches ZRELO with lifetime avg 100.00, then after 5000 further ticks (625 game days past the 14-day window) zdravje reads 99.81 and lifetime avg is still 100.00 — the 'презрело' toast fires once and nothing else happens. Second run, the rescue exploit: never water or feed the plant at all during growth; it reaches ZRELO with zdravje 0 and lifetime avg 21.26 (would grade Слаб, ~9 g). Now start watering it while it sits in ZRELO: after 1904 total ticks avg = 70.85, after 5904 avg = 90.60, after 55904 avg = 99.01. Harvesting at that point yields 59.3 g at quality 72.8 = 'Одличен' (×1.6) — indistinguishable from a perfectly tended plant. Result: harvest timing is a decision with no downside, and a ruined crop is fully recoverable by waiting.
findings.fix: Two changes in tikni(): (1) move the over-ripe subtraction above `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` so the penalty actually enters the lifetime average; (2) make the penalty beat recovery — skip the `OPORAVUVANJE` bonus when `preku > 0`, and/or raise KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN above 3.2/day. Cleaner still: stop routing over-ripeness through clamped `zdravje` and accumulate a separate `deoviPrezrelo` counter on the plant (mirroring `deoviSoStetnik`), carry it into the sushara batch in oberi(), and subtract it directly in presmetajKvalitet — that also stops the lifetime-average laundering, since a fixed penalty cannot be diluted by adding ticks.

findings.title: Lamp bonuses are read at harvest and at dry-completion time, so the lamp can be bought retroactively and upgrades everything already in the pipeline
findings.location: oberi(): `presmetajPrinos(sorta, prosekZdravje, tekovnaLampa())`; zavrsiSushenje(): `tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus`
findings.problem: Neither `prinosMult` nor `kvalitetBonus` is captured on the plant at planting time or on the batch at harvest time. Both are looked up live from `sostojba.lampa` at the moment the action resolves, so a lamp bought after a plant has finished growing (or even after it has been harvested and is sitting in the сушара) applies its full effect to that crop.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured: two Скопско Зелено plants grown to ZRELO entirely under the free Флуо lamp with identical care. Harvest bed 0 → 272.7 g wet. Buy ЛЕД Full-Spectrum, then harvest bed 1 → 409.1 g wet (exactly ×1.50) from a plant that never saw the lamp. Then finish drying BOTH: batch A, which was harvested before the purchase, comes out at quality 87.5 'Врвен' instead of the 73.5 'Одличен' it should have — it collected the +14 kvalitetBonus purely because zavrsiSushenje ran after the lamp was bought. Optimal play is therefore to buy no lamp at all while growing, fill all 12 beds plus the dryer queue, then buy the top tier once and retroactively upgrade every in-flight batch — with 12 Дојранска Ноќ beds that is on the order of 2 M ден of free value, roughly the price of the lamp itself.
findings.fix: Snapshot the lamp on the crop instead of reading it live: store `prinosMult: tekovnaLampa().prinosMult` on the plant object created in zasadiSemka(), and store `lampaBonus: tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus` on the batch pushed in oberi(); have oberi() and zavrsiSushenje() use the stored values. Add the same fallbacks in normalizirajRastenie() and the vchitaj() sushara filter for old saves.

findings.title: Professional Сушара upgrade retroactively re-grades batches already drying, and can jump a batch from 'premature' straight to 'ideal'
findings.location: zavrsiSushenje(): `const tochnost = tochnostOdSushenje(Math.floor(serija.denovi), sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara);`
findings.problem: Same root cause as the lamp: whether the player owns the сушара is read live at resolution time rather than captured on the batch in oberi(). Because owning it moves the ideal band from 9–12 to 8–14, buying it mid-dry instantly re-classifies every batch currently in the dryer.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured: two identical batches, both sitting at drying day 8. Finish batch A with no upgrade — day 8 < d1 (9), so tochnost = 0.55 'предвреме', quality 61.4 = 'Среден' (×1.1). Buy Професионална сушара (300 000), then finish batch B in the same instant — day 8 is now within 8–14, tochnost = 1.00, quality 73.5 = 'Одличен' (×1.6). A 45 % price swing on an identical batch from a purchase made after drying finished. The same trick rescues over-dried batches: a batch at day 13 or 14 scores 0.80 without the upgrade and 1.00 with it.
findings.fix: Capture `imaSushara: sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara` on the batch object pushed in oberi(), and pass `serija.imaSushara` to tochnostOdSushenje(); default it to `false` for batches loaded from older saves in the vchitaj() sushara filter. panelSushara() should use the per-batch flag for its d1/d2 display too, so the window shown matches the window that will be scored.

findings.title: A single Полеј or Ѓубри click on a freshly planted bed is guaranteed to push the plant into the damage band, and repeat Ѓубри charges 250 ден for literally nothing
findings.location: polej(): `r.voda = stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, 100)`; nahrani(): `r.hraniva = stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, 100)` after `naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)`
findings.problem: Plants start at voda 70 / hraniva 70 (zasadiSemka). VODA_DOZA is 45 and HRANA_DOZA is 40, but both actions clamp to 100 while the safe ceilings are VODA_MAX 95 and HRANA_MAX 95. 70 + 45 and 70 + 40 both clamp to 100, which is above the ceiling, so the very first care action a player performs on a new bed always starts root rot / nutrient burn. Worse, nahrani() calls naplati() BEFORE checking whether the dose can do anything, so feeding an already-full plant costs 250 ден and delivers zero nutrients while extending the burn. Neither on-bed button is disabled or annotated with the safe range, so nothing signals this.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured on a fresh Скопско Зелено bed, pari 8000, hraniva 70: click Ѓубри → hraniva 100, pari 7750 (already above HRANA_MAX 95, burn active). Click Ѓубри again → hraniva 100, pari 7500 — 250 ден spent for +0 nutrients. Click again → 7250, still +0. 14 ticks later zdravje has dropped from 100 to 92.60 from a care action the player paid for. The same happens on the first Полеј: voda 70 → 100, which is above VODA_MAX 95, so −0.8/tick root rot until it drains back under 95.
findings.fix: Clamp the doses to the safe band rather than to 100: `stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, KONFIG.VODA_MAX)` and `stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, KONFIG.HRANA_MAX)` (keep the >MAX damage rules for saves/states that are already above it). In nahrani(), bail out before naplati() when `r.hraniva >= KONFIG.HRANA_MAX` so the player is never charged for a no-op, and disable/relabel the Ѓубри button in iscrtajLeja() while the plant is already full.

findings.title: Plants never die and a completely un-cared-for crop still turns a profit, so the intended failure state does not exist
findings.location: tikni() health block (`r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje + delta, 0, 100)`) and oberi()/presmetajPrinos — there is no zdravje === 0 death path anywhere
findings.problem: zdravje is clamped at 0 but nothing consumes that; the plant keeps ageing through every phase, reaches ZRELO, and is harvestable. presmetajPrinos returns `sorta.prinos * Math.pow(zdrav, 1.2) * lampa.prinosMult` with no floor, and presmetajKvalitet has a taban of `30 * genetika` that survives regardless of health, so even a corpse grades above zero. Spec §9 asserts "With no care at all the same plant loses 95 ден, so neglect is a real failure state" — that is not what the code does.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured: plant the free starter Скопско Зелено seed and never click anything. voda hits 0, hraniva hits 0, zdravje reaches 0 by roughly game day 19 and stays there for the remaining ~55 days, yet the plant advances through VEGETACIJA → CVETANJE → ZRELO normally. Harvest and dry it: 9.36 g at quality 24.4 ('Слаб', ×0.6), which sells for roughly 505 ден at pazar 1.0 against a 150 ден seed — a net gain, not a loss. Combined with the over-ripe finding above, a zero-effort player is never punished; they simply earn less.
findings.fix: Add a death path in tikni(): track consecutive ticks at zdravje === 0 on the plant and, past a threshold (e.g. 3 game days), clear `sostojba.lei[i].rastenie`, fire a Macedonian toast, and set panelValjaSe. Alternatively (or additionally) floor the payout — have presmetajPrinos return 0 below some prosekZdravje threshold — so the seed cost is genuinely lost.

findings.title: vchitaj() does not validate sostojba.statistika fields from the save file, allowing NaN/garbage to enter state and permanently corrupt the HUD
findings.location: vchitaj() — line ~1217: `statistika: Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})`
findings.problem: Every other field restored by vchitaj() (parichnik, nivo, iskustvo, den, chas, brojLei, lampa, semki, sushara, magacin, pazar, nadgradbi) is explicitly checked with Number.isFinite/najdiSorta/etc. before being accepted, specifically to keep a corrupted or hand-edited save from injecting NaN into gameplay state (the code even has a comment to that effect: 'за оштетен сејв да не внесе NaN во парите'). The `statistika` object is the one exception: `Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})` copies every property of the saved statistika object onto the fresh one with no type or finiteness check at all.
findings.failure_scenario: Open devtools, edit the save: `let p=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('zelena-imperija-sejv')); p.s.statistika.vkupnoGrama='oops'; localStorage.setItem('zelena-imperija-sejv', JSON.stringify(p));` then reload. vchitaj() copies the string straight into sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama. `iscrtajSe()` then renders `HUD.grama.textContent = Math.round(sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama) + ' г'` → `Math.round('oops')` is `NaN`, so the HUD permanently shows 'NaN г'. Because `zavrsiSushenje()` does `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama += grama`, once it is NaN it stays NaN forever (NaN + number = NaN) for the rest of the playthrough, even across further saves/loads — the 'Вкупна берба' stat is unrecoverably broken until the player resets the game.
findings.fix: Validate each statistika field the same way the rest of vchitaj() does, e.g. `statistika: { vkupnoBerbi: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoBerbi) ? s.statistika.vkupnoBerbi : 0, vkupnoGrama: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoGrama) ? s.statistika.vkupnoGrama : 0, vkupnoZaraboteno: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoZaraboteno) ? s.statistika.vkupnoZaraboteno : 0 }` instead of an unguarded Object.assign.

verdicts.title: Overripe penalty is inert — per-tick recovery (+0.4) exceeds the day-scaled overripe penalty (-0.1875)
verdicts.reason: Confirmed in the code. Line 510 `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` (0.4/tick) then line 512 `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje + delta, 0, 100);`. The ZRELO branch at line 529 applies `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100)` = 1.5 * 0.125 = 0.1875/tick, and does NOT set `dobro = false`, so recovery still fires. Net +0.2125/tick for a plant whose voda/hraniva stay inside VODA_MIN..MAX / HRANA_MIN..MAX and has no pest — health pins at 100. Additionally `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` at line 513 runs before the penalty line, so the running average consumed by `oberi()` (`prosekZdravje = r.zbirZdravje / r.brojTikovi`, line 660) never reflects the penalty on the tick it is applied. `presmetajKvalitet` (line 430) derives quality solely from prosekZdravje/drying/genetics/pest-days, so an infinitely overripe plant grades identically to one harvested on the first ripe tick, contradicting the comment on line 528 and the TEKST.prezrelo warning.
verdicts.location: tikni(), the `else { r.faza = "ZRELO"; ... }` branch — line 529, `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100);`
verdicts.fix: Compute overripeness before the health block and fold it into `delta`: after the phase thresholds are known, if the plant is past `kCvet + KONFIG.CHASA_ZRELO_PROZOR`, do `delta -= KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN; dobro = false;` prior to line 510, and delete the standalone `r.zdravje = stegni(...)` at line 529 (keep the one-shot `izvesti(TEKST.prezrelo)` warning there). This makes the penalty per-tick like STETA_SUSA/OPORAVUVANJE and suppresses recovery, and it lands before `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje`.

verdicts.title: Side panel innerHTML is rebuilt at least once every game day (~2 real seconds), resetting scroll
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. `iscrtajPanel()` (lines 1014-1022) unconditionally assigns `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()/panelSushara()/panelMagacin()/panelNadgradbi()` on `#sodrzina`, which is the scroll container (`.sodrzina{...max-height:calc(100vh - 190px);overflow-y:auto}`, line 107; element at line 179). The market-drift block in tikni() sets `panelValjaSe = true` on every `novDen` (line 566) regardless of which tab is open, and `iscrtajSe()` calls `iscrtajPanel()` whenever the flag is set (line 1011) after every timer batch (line 1292). CHASA_PO_TIK 3 with TIK_MS 250 means one game day = 8 ticks = 2 real seconds, so the panel is wholesale replaced at least every 2s and `scrollTop` returns to 0. The author was demonstrably aware of this failure mode — the comment at lines 551-552 explains the sushara loop is throttled to whole days specifically to avoid resetting the scroll — but the novDen market block defeats it. The dropped-click sub-claim (node replaced between mousedown and mouseup on the inline `onclick` buttons) is a genuine consequence of the same wholesale replacement, though secondary to the scroll reset.
verdicts.location: iscrtajPanel() at line 1014 — the four `el.innerHTML = panel*()` assignments (lines 1019-1022)
verdicts.fix: Cache and compare before writing, and restore scroll: in `iscrtajPanel()` build the markup into a local `const html`, then `if (el.innerHTML !== html){ const skrol = el.scrollTop; el.innerHTML = html; el.scrollTop = skrol; }`. This makes the once-per-day market drift a no-op for tabs whose markup did not change (Магацин, Надградби, Сушара) while still refreshing Продавница prices.

verdicts.title: localStorage failure re-notifies every 10 seconds for the whole session
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. `zachuvaj()` (lines 1165-1172) wraps `localStorage.setItem` in try/catch whose only handler is `izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska")`, with no once-only guard, and it is invoked from `if (++brojacTikovi % KONFIG.AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI === 0) zachuvaj();` (line 570) with AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI = 40 ticks = 10 real seconds (TIK_MS 250). When setItem throws persistently (site data blocked, private-mode quota, QuotaExceededError) the condition never clears, so an identical red toast is emitted every 10s indefinitely, plus one more via the `beforeunload` handler at line 1272. Note `vchitaj()` already handles the fully-unavailable case gracefully (`catch(e){ return false; }`, line 1195), so the inconsistency is in zachuvaj() alone.
verdicts.fix: Add a module-scope `let sejvOtkazan = false;` next to the other module-level flags and change the catch to `if (!sejvOtkazan){ sejvOtkazan = true; izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska"); }` so the failure is reported exactly once per session.

verdicts.title: vchitaj() merges `statistika` from the save unvalidated
verdicts.reason: Refuted as a defect reachable in normal play. The line `statistika: Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})` (line 1217) does copy saved fields without Number.isFinite guards, but the only writers of those fields in the whole file are `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoBerbi++` (line 671), `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama += grama` (line 699) where grama derives from clamped finite math, and `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoZaraboteno += pari` (line 733). No normal-play path can write a non-finite or non-numeric value, and `zachuvaj()` serializes only what the game itself produced. Triggering NaN in the HUD requires hand-editing localStorage, which is not normal play; the surrounding guards exist to stop a corrupt save from poisoning `parichnik` (spendable currency), whereas `statistika` is display-only and feeds no economic calculation. This is a hardening suggestion, not a demonstrable defect.
verdicts.fix: No fix required.

findings.title: Полеј always adds +45 and pushes a healthy plant into the drowning-damage zone, with no safe range shown anywhere
findings.location: function polej(indeks) — `r.voda = stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, 100)` plus KONFIG `VODA_DOZA:45, VODA_MAX:95` and postaviLenta for j.bVoda
findings.problem: Watering is free, unconditional and fixed at +45. A plant is created at voda:70, so the very first time a new player presses the most obvious care button the bar goes to 100, which is above VODA_MAX (95) and triggers STETA_DAVENJE (-0.8 health per tick) until water drains back below 95 (~6.7 ticks, ~5 health lost). Water only falls 6 per game day, so any player who waters "to keep the plant happy" permanently holds the plant in the damage band. Nothing in the UI states that 20–95 is the safe band: the bar only turns red *after* the plant is already being damaged, the numeric readout has no target marker, and the toast says a flat "Полеано." even when the action just started drowning the plant. The same is true of Ѓубри (+40 vs HRANA_MAX 95).
findings.failure_scenario: New player plants the free Скопско seed. Bed shows Вода 70. They press Полеј → bar goes to 100, toast says "Полеано." They press it again a few seconds later. Health silently drains at 0.8/tick; within ~30 real seconds Здравје is at 0. presmetajPrinos returns 0 g, so the harvest, the drying batch and the sale are all worth 0 денари and 0 XP — with no message ever telling them watering was the cause.
findings.fix: Cap the dose so it cannot overshoot the safe band (`r.voda = Math.min(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, KONFIG.VODA_MAX)`, same for hraniva/HRANA_MAX), and render the safe band on the bar (e.g. a static tick/zone at 20–95 in `.zica`, plus the range in the row label or the `u` element) so the target is visible before the value goes red.

findings.title: The whole side panel is innerHTML-rebuilt every 2 real seconds, resetting its scroll position and destroying keyboard focus
findings.location: function iscrtajPanel() — `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()` etc.; triggered by `if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }` in tikni()
findings.problem: The comment above the sushara loop claims the panel refreshes "само кога ќе се смени ЦЕЛ ден" as a mitigation, but with TIK_MS 250 and CHASA_PO_TIK 3 a full game day is 8 ticks = 2 real seconds. So `panelValjaSe` is set true every 2 seconds and `#sodrzina.innerHTML` is replaced wholesale. `.sodrzina` has `max-height:calc(100vh - 190px); overflow-y:auto`, and the Надградби tab (new bed + 3 lamps + 4 upgrades) and Магацин with several batches always overflow it. Replacing innerHTML resets scrollTop to 0 and removes the focused element from the DOM, so document.activeElement falls back to <body>.
findings.failure_scenario: Player opens Надградби on a laptop, scrolls down to read "Вработен работник", and two seconds later the list jumps back to the top mid-sentence — repeatedly, making the lower half of the tab effectively unreadable. A keyboard user Tabs to "Купи семе" in Продавница; two seconds later focus is lost to <body> and Tab restarts from the top of the document, so the shop cannot be operated by keyboard at all.
findings.fix: Stop rebuilding on the daily tick: update only the values that change (market price spans, drying day/status/progress width) via cached nodes as is already done for the beds, or diff-and-patch. If a full rebuild is kept, save/restore `el.scrollTop` and re-focus `document.activeElement`'s equivalent node around the assignment.

findings.title: Player can reach a permanent dead end (no money, no seeds, no plants) with no reset available in the UI
findings.location: function naplati(iznos) / novaIgra() / the `window.__test.resetiraj` hook — there is no reset control anywhere in the HTML
findings.problem: All income comes from selling, and presmetajPrinos returns 0 g when average health is 0, so ruined plants produce a batch worth 0 денари and 0 XP. Meanwhile Ѓубри (250) and Лаб. (900) are unlimited money sinks with no confirmation. Once parichnik drops below the cheapest seed (150 for Скопско) with no seeds, no plants, nothing in Сушара and nothing in Магацин, there is no recovery path: every purchase just fires the "Немаш доволно денари" toast. The state is autosaved to localStorage every 40 ticks and on beforeunload, so reloading restores the dead game. The only way out is `window.__test.resetiraj()` from the devtools console — there is no "Нова игра" button in the markup.
findings.failure_scenario: Player over-waters all 4 beds to 0 health (see the Полеј finding) while spending on Ѓубри to try to save them. Their four harvests dry to 0 g and sell for 0 денари. Balance is under 150, all beds are empty, Сушара and Магацин are empty. Every button in the game now only produces an error toast, and reloading the page restores exactly that state.
findings.fix: Add a floor/bailout: when parichnik < cheapest seed price and there are no seeds, no plants, no sushara and no magacin entries, grant a starter seed (or a small subsidy) with an explanatory toast. Also add a visible "Нова игра" / reset button (with a confirm) to the Надградби tab or the header so a stuck save can be cleared without the console.

findings.title: A dead or ruined plant cannot be removed — the bed is locked for the rest of the full grow cycle
findings.location: function oberi(indeks) — `sostojba.lei[indeks].rastenie = null` is guarded by `if (!r || r.faza !== "ZRELO") return;` and is the only place a bed is cleared
findings.problem: There is no uproot/clear action. A plant at 0 health, or one the player planted by mistake, keeps its bed occupied until it reaches ZRELO and is harvested — that is (3+21+50)*24 game hours, i.e. ~63 game days ≈ 2 real minutes per bed even for the fastest strain, and ~3.3 minutes for Дојранска Ноќ. During that time the bed's only actions are Полеј and Ѓубри, both of which are pointless on a plant whose lifetime health average is already destroyed.
findings.failure_scenario: Player kills all four plants in the first minute. Every bed shows Здравје 0, a brown plant and only Полеј/Ѓубри buttons. They own seeds and want to start over, but cannot plant anything for the next two minutes, and no button or text explains why or what to do.
findings.fix: Add a "Искорени" (uproot) action to any planted bed — an `.opasna` button that sets `sostojba.lei[indeks].rastenie = null` (optionally with a confirm when faza is ZRELO so a ready harvest isn't thrown away).

findings.title: "Заврши сушење" is enabled from day 0 and nothing ever tells the player a batch is ready — the ideal window is only ~6 real seconds wide
findings.location: function panelSushara() — `<button onclick="zavrsiSushenje(${s.id})">Заврши сушење</button>` (never disabled), and tochnostOdSushenje()
findings.problem: Two problems in the same flow. (1) The finish button is live at day 0, when tochnostOdSushenje returns 0.55 — the worst possible multiplier — with no disabled state, no confirmation and no warning, even though the row directly above says "Прерано". A new player who was just auto-switched to this tab by oberi() sees one button and presses it. (2) Nothing signals the ideal window. With 8 ticks per game day at 250 ms, day 9 arrives 18 real seconds after harvest, day 12 at 24 s, and "Пресушено" at day 17 ≈ 34 s. There is no toast when a batch enters the window, no count/badge on the Сушара or Магацин tab buttons (`<button data-jaz="sushara">Сушара</button>` is static text), and no highlight — so the batch degrades if the player looks away for half a minute or is on another tab.
findings.failure_scenario: Player harvests, is auto-switched to Сушара, and immediately clicks the only button offered → quality locked to the 0.55 multiplier on their first ever harvest. Second attempt: they wait, switch to Продавница to buy the next seed, spend 40 seconds reading it, come back and the batch reads "Пресушено — квалитетот падна" with no notice having been given.
findings.fix: Disable the finish button while `Math.floor(s.denovi) < d1` (label it "Спремно за N дена"), fire an `izvesti()` toast when a batch first reaches d1 and again when it passes d2, and render a count badge in the Сушара/Магацин tab labels (e.g. `Сушара (2)`) so pending work is visible from any tab.

findings.title: Locked shop entries are dimmed twice (0.5 × 0.35), making the "Потребно ниво N" explanation unreadable
findings.location: CSS `.stavka.zakluceno{opacity:.5}` combined with `button:disabled{opacity:.35}`, applied together in panelProdavnica()
findings.problem: CSS opacity composites multiplicatively through the subtree, so the disabled button inside a locked `.stavka` renders at 0.175 effective alpha. Its dark text (#04150b) on the green gradient, both blended at 17.5% over the #16221b panel, yields roughly 1.4:1 contrast — far below the 4.5:1 (or even 3:1) threshold and essentially invisible. That text is the only place the game explains why five of the six strains cannot be bought. The same pattern hits the next locked bed: `.leja.zaklucena{opacity:.55}` dims the whole tile including the *enabled* `Отклучи · N ден` CTA and the "Заклучена леја"/"Леја N" labels (var(--tekst-slab) at 0.55 over the panel ≈ 3.0:1), so an affordable purchase reads as disabled.
findings.failure_scenario: A level-1 player opens Продавница and sees five greyed cards where the requirement line is illegible; they cannot tell whether the strains cost too much or need a level, and there is no other level-gating explanation in the game. Later they save up 75,000 денари but the "Отклучи" button on bed 5 still looks greyed-out, so they never try it.
findings.fix: Do not stack opacity: drop `.stavka.zakluceno{opacity:.5}` (or lower it to a border/background treatment) and give disabled buttons an explicit low-contrast-safe colour pair instead of `opacity:.35`. For the locked bed, apply the 0.55 dimming only to the `.scena`/labels and leave the `Отклучи` button at full opacity.

findings.title: Ѓубри charges 250 денари even when nutrients are already full
findings.location: function nahrani(indeks) — `if (!naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)) return; r.hraniva = stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, 100);`
findings.problem: The purchase happens before any check on the current value. At hraniva 70 the +40 is clamped to 100 (which is itself above HRANA_MAX 95 and starts STETA_PREGOR); at hraniva 100 the call is a pure no-op that still deducts 250 and still shows the success toast "Наѓубрено." The button label "Ѓубри · 250" is on every planted bed at all times with no indication that it is currently useless, and it is also the only cure for the азот event, so players are trained to press it.
findings.failure_scenario: Player presses Ѓубри on all four beds every time they check on them. On beds already near 100 nutrients they lose 250 денари per click for zero effect and get a positive confirmation toast; 32 such clicks burn the entire 8,000 starting balance while pushing every plant into the over-feeding damage band.
findings.fix: Return early with an informative toast when `r.hraniva >= KONFIG.HRANA_MAX - 5` and `r.stetnik !== "azot"` (before calling naplati), and disable / relabel the button in iscrtajLeja when fertilising would have no effect.

findings.title: No toast is announced to assistive tech, and the tab strip exposes no selected state
findings.location: `<div class="izvestuvanja" id="izvestuvanja">` + function izvesti(); `<nav class="jazicinja">` buttons with only a `.aktivno` class
findings.problem: Every piece of feedback in the game — "Немаш доволно денари", "Купено семе", "Ново ниво", harvest weight, sale price, the презрелост warning — is delivered exclusively through visual toasts in a plain div with no `role="status"` / `aria-live`, so a screen-reader user gets no notification at all; combined with `pointer-events:none` and a 3.6 s auto-remove there is also no log to go back to. Separately, the four panel tabs are plain buttons whose active state is conveyed only by colour and a border-bottom (`.aktivno`), with no `role="tab"`/`aria-selected`/`aria-current`, so which panel is showing is not exposed non-visually either.
findings.failure_scenario: A screen-reader user presses "Купи семе" without enough money. Nothing is announced; the button stays present and identical, so there is no way to tell the purchase failed. They then click Сушара and Магацин in turn and hear the same button names with no indication of which panel is now rendered below.
findings.fix: Add `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"` to `#izvestuvanja` (and use `role="alert"`/`aria-live="assertive"` for the `greska` variant), and set `aria-selected`/`aria-current="page"` on the tab buttons alongside the `.aktivno` class toggle in iscrtajPanel().

findings.title: The plant-selection modal has no dialog semantics, no Escape key, and no focus management
findings.location: `<div class="modal" id="modal">` markup, otvoriIzborSeme() (`classList.add("otvoren")`) and zatvoriModal()
findings.problem: The modal is opened purely by toggling a class. It has no `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal="true"`/`aria-labelledby`, focus is never moved into it, focus is not trapped, focus is not restored to the triggering "Засади" button on close, and there is no keydown handler for Escape — the only dismissal routes are a mouse click on the overlay backdrop or on the "Затвори" button at the bottom. Meanwhile the background page keeps re-rendering underneath and remains fully tabbable.
findings.failure_scenario: A keyboard user activates "Засади" on bed 1. The dialog appears but focus stays on the (now visually obscured) bed button; pressing Escape does nothing; Tab walks through the entire header and all twelve bed action buttons behind the overlay before eventually reaching the "Засади"/"Затвори" controls inside it — and the panel rebuild every 2 s keeps resetting where Tab lands.
findings.fix: Give the modal `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modal-naslov"`, focus the first button inside it on open, restore focus to the opener on close, add a `keydown` listener closing it on Escape, and cycle Tab between the first/last focusable elements inside `.modal-kutija`.

findings.title: On narrow screens the Сушара/Магацин panel sits below ~1500 px of beds, and harvesting silently switches to a tab that is off-screen
findings.location: CSS `@media(max-width:1020px){.raspored{grid-template-columns:1fr}}` combined with `aktivnoJazice = "sushara"` in oberi() and `aktivnoJazice = "magacin"` in zavrsiSushenje()
findings.problem: Below 1020 px the aside stacks after `<main class="lei">`. With 4 unlocked beds plus the offered locked one, each tile is roughly 300 px tall in a single column at 360 px wide, so the tab strip starts about 1,500 px down the page. oberi() and zavrsiSushenje() change the active tab and re-render, but the player is scrolled to the beds and sees no change at all; there is no scrollIntoView and no link from the toast to the panel. The same applies to the empty-seed modal, which says "Купи од продавницата" but offers no way to get there.
findings.failure_scenario: On a 360 px phone the player harvests bed 1. The toast says "…Оди во сушара", the panel silently switches to Сушара 1,500 px below the viewport, and the player is left scrolling the whole bed grid to find it — and by the time they do (18–34 s is the entire ideal drying window) the batch may already be past its peak.
findings.fix: After the auto tab switch in oberi()/zavrsiSushenje(), call `document.querySelector('.jazicinja').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'})` when the single-column layout is active, and make the "Немаш семки" modal body include a button that closes the modal, sets aktivnoJazice="prodavnica" and scrolls to the panel.

findings.title: Toasts stack without limit and overlay the side panel's own buttons
findings.location: CSS `.izvestuvanja{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:14px;flex-direction:column}` and izvesti(), which appends unconditionally with a 3.6 s removal timer
findings.problem: Nothing caps the number of simultaneous toasts. Each is ~40 px tall with a 7 px gap and lives 3.6 s, and the container is anchored bottom-right — exactly on top of the 370 px sticky side panel, whose Продај / Лаб. / Заврши сушење buttons sit in that region. Rapid actions (Полеј is free and instant, selling several batches, a level-up plus a sale plus a harvest at once) produce a column that covers the lower part of the panel and can grow past the top of the viewport, where the excess toasts are simply not visible.
findings.failure_scenario: Player sells five dried batches in a row from Магацин. Ten toasts (sale + level-up) stack up the right edge, hiding the Продај buttons of the remaining batches for several seconds, and the earliest ones scroll off the top of the screen unread.
findings.fix: Cap the stack — in izvesti(), remove the oldest child while `kutija.children.length >= 4` — and either move the container to bottom-left or add bottom padding to `.sodrzina` so the toasts do not sit on top of the panel's action buttons.

findings.title: Side-panel scroll position resets every ~2 seconds during normal play
findings.location: tikni() market-drift block (`if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }`, lines ~560-567) combined with iscrtajPanel() (`el.innerHTML = ...`, lines ~1014-1023)
findings.problem: Every in-game day (which passes every ~2 real seconds per KONFIG.TIK_MS/CHASA_PO_TIK) the market-drift loop unconditionally sets the global `panelValjaSe` flag. `iscrtajSe()` then calls `iscrtajPanel()`, which does `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()/panelSushara()/panelMagacin()/panelNadgradbi()` for whichever tab is currently active — a full DOM replacement with no scrollTop save/restore anywhere in the file. This happens regardless of whether the active tab's data actually changed (e.g. browsing Надградби, which has no market data, still gets wiped every 2s because the flag is global, not per-panel). This directly contradicts the design spec's own stated intent ("Shop / inventory / market lists re-render only when their backing data changes ... No innerHTML churn in the hot path").
findings.failure_scenario: A player opens the Надградби tab (8 stacked items: nova leja + 3 lamps + 4 upgrades) on a laptop where the panel is taller than the viewport, scrolls down to read the Работник upgrade description, and before they finish reading, the list is fully rebuilt and their scroll position snaps back to the top — every single game day, i.e. roughly every 2 real seconds for as long as they stay on that tab.
findings.fix: Scope `panelValjaSe` per source of change (e.g. a `panelValjaSeZaProdavnica` flag set only by market drift, separate from beds/sushara/magacin flags) so unrelated tabs are not rebuilt on market drift; and/or capture `el.scrollTop` before `el.innerHTML = ...` in `iscrtajPanel()` and restore it after.

findings.title: Harvesting or finishing a dry batch force-switches the side panel away from whatever tab the player has open
findings.location: oberi() (`aktivnoJazice = "sushara"; panelValjaSe = true; iscrtajSe();`, lines ~674-676) and zavrsiSushenje() (`aktivnoJazice = "magacin"; ...`, lines ~702-704)
findings.problem: Both functions unconditionally overwrite the global `aktivnoJazice` state to jump the side panel to Сушара/Магацин, with no check of what tab the player currently has open and no way to opt out.
findings.failure_scenario: A player is on the Надградби tab deciding what to buy next (e.g. scrolled down comparing lamp upgrades) and clicks Обери on a ready bed in the main grid — an action in a completely different part of the screen. The side panel is yanked away from Надградби to Сушара mid-decision, discarding their place with no confirmation.
findings.fix: Only switch `aktivnoJazice` automatically the first time a player has never visited that tab, or replace the forced switch with a non-destructive cue (e.g. a badge/dot on the Сушара/Магацин tab button) that lets the player choose when to navigate there.

findings.title: Seed-picker modal has no dialog semantics, focus management, or Escape handling
findings.location: `<div class="modal" id="modal">` markup (lines ~185-191) and otvoriIzborSeme()/zatvoriModal() (lines ~587-611)
findings.problem: The modal container has no `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal="true"`/accessible label, `otvoriIzborSeme()` never moves focus into the dialog when it opens (focus stays on the background "Засади" button), and there is no keydown listener anywhere in the file for the Escape key (confirmed via grep — no `role=`, `aria-`, `focus(`, or `Escape` outside the one `aria-hidden` on the decorative SVG).
findings.failure_scenario: A keyboard-only or screen-reader user clicks/activates "Засади" on an empty bed. The modal opens visually, but focus remains on the trigger button (or wherever it was), so a screen reader gives no indication a dialog appeared, Tab cycles through the page behind the dimmed overlay instead of the strain list, and there is no way to close the modal with Escape — only by tabbing to "Затвори" or clicking the backdrop.
findings.fix: Add `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` to `.modal-kutija`, move focus to the first strain button (or the modal container) when `otvoriIzborSeme()` opens it, add a `keydown` listener that closes the modal on Escape, and return focus to the triggering bed's button on close.

verdicts.title: Over-ripening penalty is fully cancelled by passive health recovery, and the unweighted lifetime average lets a ruined plant be rehabilitated in ZRELO
verdicts.reason: Confirmed by arithmetic on the actual constants. CHASA_PO_TIK=3 (line 200) → delDena=0.125, so the ZRELO penalty at line 529 is KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN(1.5)*0.125 = 0.1875 per tick, while `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE` (line 510) adds 0.4 per tick to any plant whose voda/hraniva are in band and has no pest. Net +0.2125/tick, so zdravje sits pinned at the 100 clamp and over-ripening costs literally nothing — spec line 92 ("quality decays 1.5 points per game day") is not what the code produces. The second half is also real: prosekZdravje = zbirZdravje / brojTikovi (line 661) is an unweighted lifetime mean, ZRELO has no exit condition, and each extra tick adds a fresh 100 to zbirZdravje, so parking a neglected plant in ZRELO with care asymptotically launders its average back toward 100 and restores full yield and grade. One sub-claim in the finding is inaccurate and should not be repeated: the penalty is not permanently invisible to prosekZdravje — line 529 mutates r.zdravje persistently, so it is captured by `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` (line 513) on the *following* tick. The ordering only delays the penalty by one tick; the reason it never bites is that recovery outweighs it.
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html, tikni(): the ZRELO else-branch at line 529 (`r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100);`) together with line 510 (`if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;`) and line 513 (`r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje;`)
verdicts.fix: In tikni(), compute `preku` before the health block and skip the OPORAVUVANJE bonus when `preku > 0` so the penalty is not cancelled. To also stop the lifetime-average laundering, add a `deoviPrezrelo` counter on the plant (mirroring `deoviSoStetnik`, initialised in zasadiSemka() at line 623 and normalised in normalizirajRastenie() near line 1187), increment it by `delDena` in the same else-branch, carry it into the sushara batch pushed in oberi() (line ~666), and subtract it directly inside presmetajKvalitet() instead of routing it through the clamped `zdravje`.

verdicts.title: Lamp bonuses are read live at harvest and dry-completion, so a lamp bought later retroactively upgrades everything already in the pipeline
verdicts.reason: Confirmed verbatim in the code. oberi() calls `presmetajPrinos(sorta, prosekZdravje, tekovnaLampa())` at line 662, and zavrsiSushenje() passes `tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus` at line 688; `tekovnaLampa()` (line 351) reads `sostojba.lampa` at call time. Neither `prinosMult` nor `kvalitetBonus` is stored on the plant in zasadiSemka() (lines 620-624) or on the batch pushed in oberi() (lines 666-669), and the batch record carries only `{id, sorta, gramaVlazno, denovi, prosekZdravje, deoviSoStetnik}`. So a plant grown entirely under Флуо gets the full ×1.50 yield if the lamp is bought in the instant before harvest, and a batch already sitting in the сушара gets the full +14 quality if the lamp is bought before it is pulled. Reachable in ordinary play — buying a lamp is a normal purchase and every in-flight crop silently benefits.
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html, oberi() line 662 (`const suvo = presmetajPrinos(sorta, prosekZdravje, tekovnaLampa());`) and zavrsiSushenje() line 688 (`tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus`)
verdicts.fix: Snapshot the lamp instead of reading it live: store `prinosMult: tekovnaLampa().prinosMult` on the plant object created in zasadiSemka() (line 621) and use `r.prinosMult` in oberi(); store `lampaBonus: tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus` on the batch pushed in oberi() (line 666) and pass `serija.lampaBonus` in zavrsiSushenje(). Add fallbacks for old saves in normalizirajRastenie() (line ~1185) and the vchitaj() sushara filter.

verdicts.title: Professional Сушара upgrade retroactively re-grades batches already drying
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. zavrsiSushenje() line 685 reads `sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara` live: `const tochnost = tochnostOdSushenje(Math.floor(serija.denovi), sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara);`. tochnostOdSushenje() (lines 448-455) moves the ideal band from 9-12 to 8-14 when the flag is set, so a batch at day 8 scores 0.55 without the upgrade and 1.00 with it, and a batch at day 13-14 scores 0.80 vs 1.00. The batch record built in oberi() (lines 666-669) stores no per-batch flag, so buying the 300 000 упgrade re-grades every batch currently in the dryer. Same root cause as the lamp finding and independently reachable.
verdicts.fix: Add `imaSushara: sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara` to the batch object pushed in oberi() (line 666) and pass `serija.imaSushara` to tochnostOdSushenje() in zavrsiSushenje(); default it to `false` for batches loaded from older saves in the vchitaj() sushara filter, and use the same per-batch flag when panelSushara() renders the d1/d2 window.

verdicts.title: Ѓубри charges 250 ден before checking whether the dose can do anything (the dose-clamp half of this finding is refuted)
verdicts.reason: Split verdict. REFUTED: the claim that clamping the dose to 100 rather than to VODA_MAX/HRANA_MAX is a bug. Spec line 133 specifies exactly `Полевање +45 voda` and `Ѓубриво +40 hraniva`, and spec line ~119 specifies both stats clamp to 0-100; spec line 127 states outright that over-watering hurting is the intended asymmetry that makes the care loop a skill. Lines 633 and 641 implement the spec as written, and the overshoot is avoidable — waiting until voda ≤ 50 gives exactly 95, which is not > VODA_MAX. CONFIRMED: the narrower charging bug. nahrani() (lines 639-645) calls `naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)` at line 641 before the clamp, so with hraniva already at 100 and no `azot` pest the player is charged 250 ден for a strictly zero effect, repeatably, with the button still enabled and no warning.
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html, nahrani() line 641 (`if (!naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)) return;`) — the call precedes `r.hraniva = stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, 100);` on the next line
verdicts.fix: In nahrani(), before `naplati()`, return early when the dose cannot help and there is nothing to cure: `if (r.hraniva >= 100 && r.stetnik !== "azot") { izvesti(...); return; }`. Optionally disable the Ѓубри button in iscrtajLeja() under the same condition. Do NOT change the +45 / +40 dose values or the 0-100 clamps — those match the spec.

verdicts.title: Plants never die and an un-cared-for crop still turns a profit, contradicting spec §9
verdicts.reason: Confirmed both structurally and numerically. There is no zdravje === 0 death path anywhere: line 512 clamps zdravje to 0 and nothing consumes that value, the phase ladder at lines 516-535 advances on `vozrast` alone, and oberi() (line 656) gates only on `r.faza !== "ZRELO"`. presmetajPrinos() (line 397) has no floor and presmetajKvalitet() (line 438) grants a `30 * genetika` taban regardless of health. I simulated the starter Скопско Зелено with zero care using the exact tick constants: lifetime average health 17.4, yield 7.37 g, quality 22.3 → Слаб (×0.6) → about 398 ден at pazar 1.0 against a 150 ден seed, i.e. roughly +248 net. Spec line 216 asserts the same plant *loses* 95 ден and that neglect is a real failure state; the code pays out instead. (An untreated pest does not change the sign — it drives quality to 0 but the grade is already Слаб ×0.6 and yield is unaffected by the pest kazna.)
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html, tikni() health clamp line 512 (`r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje + delta, 0, 100);`) and presmetajPrinos() line 397 (`return sorta.prinos * Math.pow(zdrav, 1.2) * lampa.prinosMult;`) — no zdravje === 0 branch exists in either
verdicts.fix: Either add a death path in tikni(): track consecutive ticks at `r.zdravje === 0` on the plant, and past ~3 game days set `sostojba.lei[i].rastenie = null`, fire a Macedonian toast via izvesti(..., "greska") and set panelValjaSe; or floor the payout by having presmetajPrinos() return 0 below a prosekZdravje threshold, so the seed cost is genuinely lost.

verdicts.title: vchitaj() does not validate sostojba.statistika fields, allowing NaN to permanently corrupt HUD stats
verdicts.reason: Line 1217: `statistika: Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})` copies every property of the saved statistika object with zero type/finiteness checking, unlike every other field restored in the same Object.assign (parichnik, nivo, iskustvo, den, chas, brojLei, lampa at lines 1209-1216), which all use Number.isFinite guards. A non-numeric statistika field (e.g. from a hand-edited or corrupted save) flows straight into sostojba.statistika, and since zavrsiSushenje() (line 699: `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama += grama`) and the earnings tracker (line 733: `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoZaraboteno += pari`) use +=, a NaN value is permanently sticky (NaN + n = NaN) for the rest of the playthrough, including across further save/reload cycles. iscrtajSe() (line 1005) then renders `Math.round(sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama) + ' г'` as 'NaN г' in the HUD. This is exactly the corruption scenario the code's own neighboring comment (~line 1228: 'за оштетен сејв да не внесе NaN во парите') says it is trying to prevent everywhere else — statistika is the one field left unguarded.
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html: function vchitaj(), line 1217 `statistika: Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})`
verdicts.fix: Validate each statistika field explicitly, e.g. `statistika: { vkupnoBerbi: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoBerbi) ? s.statistika.vkupnoBerbi : 0, vkupnoGrama: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoGrama) ? s.statistika.vkupnoGrama : 0, vkupnoZaraboteno: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoZaraboteno) ? s.statistika.vkupnoZaraboteno : 0 }` instead of the unguarded Object.assign.

verdicts.title: Side-panel scroll position resets every ~2 seconds during normal play
verdicts.reason: Verified: KONFIG.TIK_MS=250, CHASA_PO_TIK=3, so 8 ticks = 1 game day = 2 real seconds (line 200 comment confirms). In tikni(), the `if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }` block (lines 560-567) unconditionally sets the global panelValjaSe flag on every day rollover, regardless of which tab (aktivnoJazice) is active. iscrtajSe() (line 1011) then calls iscrtajPanel() whenever panelValjaSe is true, which does `el.innerHTML = ...` (lines 1019-1022) for whichever panel is active, with no scrollTop save/restore anywhere in the file (grep for scrollTop/focus confirms none). This means even a tab with no market data (e.g. Надградби) gets its DOM fully replaced every 2 seconds, resetting scroll position — directly contradicting the code's own comment at line 550-551 acknowledging the panel should not be needlessly rebuilt for exactly this reason (a nearly identical safeguard exists for the sushara loop at line 556, but is missing for the market-drift block).
verdicts.location: tikni() market-drift block lines 560-567 (`if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }`) combined with iscrtajPanel() lines 1014-1023 (`el.innerHTML = ...`)
verdicts.fix: Scope the market-drift flag separately (e.g. only set panelValjaSe when aktivnoJazice === "prodavnica", or use a per-panel dirty flag) so tabs unrelated to market pricing are not rebuilt every game day; alternatively capture and restore el.scrollTop around the innerHTML assignment in iscrtajPanel().

verdicts.title: Harvesting or finishing a dry batch force-switches the side panel away from whatever tab the player has open
verdicts.reason: Verified at lines 673-676 (oberi) and 701-704 (zavrsiSushenje): both unconditionally set `aktivnoJazice = "sushara"` / `"magacin"` and `panelValjaSe = true` then call iscrtajSe(), with no check of the player's current tab and no opt-out. This will jump the panel away from whatever the player was viewing (e.g. Надградби) purely because they clicked Обери on a bed, an unrelated part of the screen.
verdicts.location: oberi() lines 673-676 (`aktivnoJazice = "sushara"; panelValjaSe = true; iscrtajSe();`) and zavrsiSushenje() lines 701-704 (`aktivnoJazice = "magacin"; ...`)
verdicts.fix: Only auto-switch aktivnoJazice the first time that tab has never been visited, or replace the forced switch with a non-destructive badge/dot cue on the Сушара/Магацин tab button, leaving navigation to the player.

verdicts.title: Seed-picker modal has no dialog semantics, focus management, or Escape handling
verdicts.reason: Verified via grep: the only role=/aria-/focus(/Escape occurrence in the whole file is the decorative `aria-hidden="true"` on an SVG (line 801). The modal markup at lines 185-191 (`<div class="modal" id="modal">` / `.modal-kutija`) has no role or aria-modal attribute, and there is no keydown listener for Escape anywhere, nor any .focus() call moving focus into the dialog when it opens.
verdicts.location: `<div class="modal" id="modal">` markup lines 185-191, and otvoriIzborSeme()/zatvoriModal() (grep confirms no role=, aria-, focus(, or Escape handling anywhere in the file besides the decorative SVG aria-hidden)
verdicts.fix: Add role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" to .modal-kutija, call .focus() on the first strain button (or the modal container) when the modal opens, add a document keydown listener that calls zatvoriModal() on Escape, and return focus to the triggering button on close.

verdicts.title: Mismatched quotation marks in drying-complete toast
verdicts.reason: Line 303 confirmed: `Сушењето заврши: ${g} г, оценка „${o}".` opens with „ (U+201E) and closes with ASCII " instead of “ (U+201C). Verbatim match to candidate.
verdicts.fix: Change to `Сушењето заврши: ${g} г, оценка „${o}“.` using U+201C as the closing quote.

verdicts.title: Singular/plural agreement broken: "Имаш 1 семки"
verdicts.reason: Line 1041 hardcodes plural 'семки'; line 335 confirms novaIgra() starts the player with semki:{skopsko:1}, so the very first screen shows the ungrammatical singular case.
verdicts.fix: Use ` · Имаш ${imam} ${imam === 1 ? "семка" : "семки"}`.

verdicts.title: Nitrogen-deficiency button text contradicts the mechanic
verdicts.reason: Line 995 renders 'Ѓубри против азот' only when n.tretman is null (line 993), which per NASTANI (line 275, id:azot, tretman:null) is exclusively the nitrogen-deficiency event, and it's cured by fertilizing (nahrani, lines 495/642, TEKST.samoGubrenje at 301/650 confirms fertilizing is the fix). 'Против азот' (against nitrogen) contradicts adding nitrogen via fertilizer.
verdicts.fix: Change label to 'Ѓубри со азот' or 'Наѓубри — недостаток на азот'.

verdicts.title: Missing definite article in "Оди во сушара"
verdicts.reason: Line 302 confirmed verbatim; the drying room is referred to elsewhere with the definite form 'Сушарата' and tab label 'Сушара' as a specific facility, so the bare indefinite form is a genuine grammatical inconsistency, not a style nit.
verdicts.fix: Change to 'Оди во сушарата.'

verdicts.title: "г мокро" ungrammatical and inconsistent with "г мокра маса"
verdicts.reason: Line 1070 confirmed: `${Math.round(s.gramaVlazno)} г мокро`, while the harvest toast at line 302 for the same quantity (gramaVlazno) says 'г мокра маса' — a real internal inconsistency in the same data field's label.
verdicts.fix: Use 'г мокра маса' to match line 302's phrasing.

verdicts.title: Latin script leaks into lamp name "ЛЕД Full-Spectrum"
verdicts.reason: Line 257 confirmed verbatim; other lamp entries in the same array use fully transliterated Cyrillic names, making this the one item mixing raw Latin text into player-facing Cyrillic UI.
